Mod.Name: More Scavenging
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Adds extra scavenging attempts at the dumping ground every night: 1000 by default, 0 to 10000 in this mod's settings. By default the injury risk stops climbing after your normal number of attempts, so the extra ones stay usable; turn that off in the settings for the vanilla risk curve.
